# Ensemble samples

The viola, cello, contrabass, flute, oboe, clarinet and bassoon presets in this directory are the FluidR3 GM WebAudioFont builds distributed by the [WebAudioFont instrument catalog](https://surikov.github.io/webaudiofontdata/sound/). Their FluidR3 copyright notices and MIT license are reproduced in [LICENSE-FluidR3.md](LICENSE-FluidR3.md).

Each preset is bundled locally so the chord ensembles can play without a network connection. The existing violin preset supplies the soprano string part.
